transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because... for months now, I've been seeing the exact same pattern. My sister's appointments keep getting moved, bills show up wrong, and people constantly just forget to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me that it's just mistakes or coincidences, but I know better. I know they're deliberately keeping information from me. They're trying to push me out of making decisions.
Have you been hearing voices that other people do not hear?

No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or anything like that. It's... it's just the actual things happening around me, the things people are doing with the schedules and the paperwork. I'm not imagining sounds, I'm just seeing what's going on.
Have you noticed your thoughts ever get jumbled or hard to follow when you’re talking?

No, I haven't. My thoughts are perfectly clear. I don't lose my train of thought or get confused when I'm talking. If anything, I'm very organized—I've been an office supervisor for years, so keeping information straight is just what I do. I know exactly what I'm saying... it's just that the people around me don't want to listen to the points I'm making.
Have you been avoiding being around other people because of these concerns?

No, I haven't. I mean, I still go to work every day and do my job. I'm not hiding from anyone. I still talk to my sister and my coworkers just like I always have. I just... well, I have to be a lot more careful around them now, obviously, because of what they're trying to pull. But I certainly don't avoid being around people.
Have you ever believed that others were controlling your thoughts or actions?

No, absolutely not. My thoughts are entirely my own. I make my own decisions, and I do what I choose to do. I don't... I don't even know how someone would control another person's mind like that. So no, nobody is controlling my thoughts or my actions. I'm just dealing with the reality of what they are doing behind my back.
